gloss_en: Check which elements in the Navisworks-bound IFC have no properties at all
prompt: can u list everything in the ifc that has no property sets, navis shows empty tabs for a bunch of stuff
expected_behavior: List elements with zero IfcPropertySet/QTO relations, group by IFC class, flag likely export-setting causes.

gloss_en: Compare architect IFC vs structural IFC origin offset
prompt: arch ifc and struct ifc dont line up when appended, one is like 2km off. whats the placement/site origin in each?
expected_behavior: Report IfcSite/IfcMapConversion/placement and bounding box origin of each model, estimate offset vector, suggest fix at export.

prompt: any geometry further than 10km from origin? ACC model coordination is showing it floating
expected_behavior: Scan element placements, list outliers beyond threshold, give counts and sample GUIDs.

prompt: before I push to ACC how many IfcBuildingElementProxy are in here and which categories
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by ObjectType/Revit category, advise mapping.

prompt: ACC keeps saying new version but clash results reset, are GUIDs stable? check dups in this file
expected_behavior: Detect duplicate GlobalIds within the file; explain that GUID changes across exports break issue tracking; cannot compare to prior version unless provided.

gloss_en: Why did my IFC upload fail in ACC
prompt: ifc upload failed in acc docs, no error just 'failed to process'. file is 900mb. whats wrong w it?
expected_behavior: Inspect file validity, schema header, size, units; suggest splitting or reducing and checking supported IFC versions.

gloss_en: Export a property list for Navisworks search sets
prompt: need all psets+prop names present in this model so I can build search sets in navis
expected_behavior: Export unique pset/property names with element counts per class.

prompt: navis shows my ifc 1000x too big. what units is it in
expected_behavior: Report IfcUnitAssignment length unit and conversion; likely mm vs m mismatch.

prompt: selection tree in navis has no levels just one big blob, does the ifc even have storeys
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey and containment; count elements not contained in any storey.

gloss_en: Find elements without color or material
prompt: in autodesk viewer everything is grey, are there styles/materials in this ifc
expected_behavior: Count elements with IfcStyledItem / material associations; explain viewer behavior.

gloss_en: Rename a property for Navisworks tab
prompt: can you rename pset 'Pset_WallCommon' fields... actually just copy FireRating into a custom pset 'Coord' on all walls
expected_behavior: Create a custom pset with copied FireRating on all IfcWall, report count modified.

prompt: two ifcs, are there walls in both at the same spot (dups) before I append them
expected_behavior: Compare wall geometry bounding boxes across two files, report overlaps/duplicates.

prompt: does bim360 viewer open ifc4 or only 2x3? asking before client sends
expected_behavior: Explain how to check the schema in the file header; note supported versions must be confirmed in current Autodesk docs.

gloss_en: Revit link vs IFC in Navisworks
prompt: why does my rvt show properties in navis but the ifc of the same model doesnt
expected_behavior: Explain IFC export property-set settings (Export Revit property sets, base quantities) and how to verify the exported file.
